real-dialog-scrollback-then-idle.txt

  read-screen of a live Claude Code session (last 12 rows).
  This is the case `--lines N` produces after the operator answers the
  dialog: the dialog is still in the window but the input box is back.
  Expected classification: prompt_idle.
